newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia palm oil markets closed for holiday.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia palm oil markets closed for holiday.

text.p: Malaysian crude palmoil futures, physicals and palm kernel oil futures markets are closed on Thursday for the Labour Day holiday.
On Wednesday, Palm oil prices finished a shade higher aided by technical buying and shortcovering ahead of the holiday.
At the close, the July futures was five ringgit higher at 1,281 ringgit ($510.76) a tonne.
"We expect July futures to trade in a narrow range on Friday unless some supportive leads appear," another trader said.
